cost_assessment.source: Fixed v1 Sections 2/5/6, Appendices A/E/H; https://arxiv.org/html/2611.17334v1
cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.model_scale: Common-data 0.6B--6.4B multimodal backbones and a dedicated 0.4B vision capacity ladder
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: From-scratch lifetime-compute comparisons around 1e22 FLOPs; eight-GPU training throughput and H200 TTFT matrix with 16 concurrent requests.
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: The full pretraining/capacity/placement/model-size matrix exceeds a short single-device budget; this is a configuration-based inference, not an attempted run or an invented GPU-hour estimate.
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；不下载权重或训练数据，只实现视觉mask加性QKVO/SwiGLU与联合因果注意力的小张量机制。

summary: 将视觉专属容量从pre-fusion移入前部backbone：共享投影上加vision-only QKVO，FFN同输入并联SwiGLU，零初始化新增输出以保持起点等价。本地单层小张量L1，不是完整MLLM或论文TTFT复现；完整实验高成本不复现。
